notes: The supplied text (catalog pages 47-48) has no section headed Cybersecurity. It contains: the tail of an unnamed award at the top of page 47, the Associate in Science in Information Technology, the Certificate of Achievement in IT Service and Support, and the start of the Associate in Science in IT Service and Support.

The unnamed section at the top of page 47 begins mid-section with no heading. It lists Major Field CNET-146, CNET-155A, CNET-162 and CNET-170 (12.0 units), then electives of at least 6 units including CNET-173, CNET-174 and CNET-175, for a total of 18.0-21.0. It is followed directly by the A.S. in Information Technology, and its outcomes refer to the IT career field. It is most likely the Certificate of Achievement in Information Technology continued from page 46, not Cybersecurity. Its major field includes CNET-155A and CNET-162, which are not on the Cybersecurity closed list, so it was not recorded as this award.
The Cybersecurity curriculum guide is probably on a different page of chapter 7. A reviewer should locate it and re-extract.
